name: Cross-account trust confined to an org (StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID) - constraint, not expansion
note: IAM-805 (constraint polarity, contrast with acceptance-suite test 10). StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID confines trust to principals INSIDE the named organization - a constraint. This must lower severity and must NOT be misread as the StringNotEquals expansion (which is the critical org-exclusion case). No 'missing PrincipalOrgID' remediation.
rationale: aws:PrincipalOrgID with the StringEquals operator confines trust to principals that belong to the named AWS Organization (o-exampleorgid). Per the polarity rule, StringEquals on this key is a CONSTRAINT that narrows who may assume the role and lowers path-exploitability - the inverse of StringNotEquals, which is the critical org-EXCLUSION expansion (acceptance test 10). The analyzer must classify this operator as a protective org restriction, must NOT flip it to an expansion finding, and must NOT emit a 'missing aws:PrincipalOrgID' remediation, since the key is present with constraining polarity. Severity stays at or below medium. The assumed role's permissions remain out of scope / unknown. Ref: AWS global condition key aws:PrincipalOrgID; docs/trust-policy-semantics.md sec 4.2.
